name: Sailor's Warning (1-2)

source.title: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-00: Salt of the Ocean

disable: DC 14 Arcana check (trained) to repair Chamenaiti's magic, DC 17 Religion check or DC 17 Occultism check (trained) to offset the prayer, or Dispel Magic (1st rank; counteract DC 14) to counteract the warning
routine: a Rubbery crimson tentacles appear from a rip in the air and grasp at all creatures in the area, dealing 1d4 bludgeoning damage (DC 17 basic Fortitude save save).

items.name: Blood Sacrifice

text: An illusory cyclops in oracular robes cries out a warning, but then dissolves into a violent phantasmal cyclops, which calls out for the Blind Formless Chaos That Lies Behind the Stars to accept his sacrifice. It then plunges an obsidian athame into a creature's chest, summoning a foul entity.
